references.text: The original instruction to make carrying poles of acacia wood for the altar of burnt offering, as described in Exodus 38:6.
Describes carrying poles of acacia wood for the ark of the covenant, showing the same pattern of carrying poles for holy objects in the tabernacle.
Carrying poles of acacia wood for the altar of incense, using the same construction method as for the altar in Exodus 38:6.
Parallel text about carrying poles of acacia wood for the ark of the covenant, showing consistent use of this material for carrying poles.
Carrying poles of acacia wood for the table of showbread, using the same craftsmanship technique as in Exodus 38:6.
Carrying poles of acacia wood for the altar of incense, parallel to the construction of the carrying poles in Exodus 38:6.
